replies.rawMarkdown:
And I'm going to guess early access to the model maybe the root cause there, saying that as my first submission with it is 6 hours in because of issues I had downloading it. But I am genuinely suspicious of the performance boost and I think that the runners of this competition need to do an ablation test as to whether the increase in performance hits all 110 games roughly equally or only the ones that were in the supposedly elite private validation set.

The response if so is obvious, rescore against the games that weren't in that validation set retroactively and going forward. Otherwise, nice work on the model! But it's intellectually dishonest to not behave as if we live in an age of ruthless benchmaxing.
